candidate_extension.pure_bound_admission: For each affected site and polarity, the finite field bank is exactly the disjoint union of complete packets owned by incident primary dressed-SC relations; no free channel of that polarity is present.

source_macro.activation: reserve_phase_0 plus blank target packet -> primary_phase_1 plus complete target packet
source_macro.withdrawal: primary_phase_0 plus complete target packet -> reserve_phase_1 plus packet removal
source_macro.hold: advance A9 phase and retime the complete packet to the output C4/C3 frame
source_macro.site_layer_action: decrement C3 unless the site is claimed by a circulation-frame plaquette

circulation_frame.boundary_phase_pattern: role_i carries C4 phase offset_plus_i mod 4
circulation_frame.tick: swap active and reserve two-edge paths, advance all four C4 phases, replace sixteen input packet bits by sixteen output packet bits, and stall the four vertex C3 layers
circulation_frame.conflict_exclusion: Shared-edge phase and parity demand incompatible ownership for same-plane neighbors; distinct plane families demand incompatible C3 layers at every shared vertex.
